description: I'm Aga, an ML developer from Nigeria and founder of VelkroLM, an AI lab building small models and tools for African languages. We're building FieldShift NG, a tool that turns NASA data into plain-language decisions for Nigerian farmers, from planting to flood risk to when to sell. I'm looking for a frontend developer, a data/GIS person, someone with agriculture knowledge, and a designer. If you're curious and want to build something that matters, join us.
